top_cited_works.title: Pontryagin Neural Networks for High-Fidelity Cislunar Orbital Transfers
top_cited_works.venue: Journal of Guidance Control and Dynamics
top_cited_works.abstract: This paper leverages Pontryagin Neural Networks (PoNNs) to solve minimum-time low-energy low-thrust cislunar optimal transfers in a high-fidelity ephemeris model. PoNNs are neural networks tailored for solving two-point boundary value problems derived from the application of the Pontryagin Minimum Principle to optimal control problems (OCPs). Within PoNNs, the authors employ the Extreme Theory of Functional Connections to approximate state and costate using the constrained expressions to analytically satisfy the boundary conditions. The problems investigated regard a small spacecraft initially on a ballistic lunar transfer (BLT) directed to an elliptic lunar polar orbit, and a high elliptic earth orbit, transferred then to a series of BLTs reaching the Lunar Gateway. To solve these OCPs, the authors blend the PoNN classical framework with the particle swarm optimization, the penalty method, and some algebraic manipulations to analytically solve the transversality conditions arising from the variability of the departure orbit.
